question: Badruddin Tyabji addressed the congress as president in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1887.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Badruddin Tyabji** was the** third president** of the **Indian National Congress.**
 
• He was a prominent lawyer and a member of the** Bombay Bar Association.**
 
• He presided over the **Congress session in 1887**, which was held in** Madras (now Chennai).**
 
• During his presidency, he emphasized the** need for unity** among different communities and regions in India.
 
• Tyabji played a significant role in the** Indian independence movement** and was a supporter of the Swadeshi movement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 1888: The fourth session of the Indian National Congress was held at Allahabad under the presidency of George Yule, who became the first Englishman to preside over the Congress.
 
• 1885: The first session of the Indian National Congress was held at Bombay under the presidency of Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee. It marked the formal beginning of the national political movement in India.
 
• 1886: The second session of the Congress was held at Calcutta under the presidency of Dadabhai Naoroji, an important nationalist leader known as the “Grand Old Man of India”.
